purpose: Business Analytics semantic mappings, tenant isolation and deterministic insight persistence
invariants: All mappings and insights are tenant scoped
Every active analytics mapping declares DEDICATED_SOURCE or TENANT_COLUMN isolation
TENANT_COLUMN mappings provide a validated physical tenant field and tenant value
Analytics queries never aggregate a shared source without an explicit tenant predicate
Clients and LLMs never provide executable SQL
Only registered semantic mappings resolve physical identifiers
Unconfigured metrics are never represented as numeric zero
Insights are derived from analytics results and are not transactional source of truth
Insight generation is idempotent for the same tenant, metric, classification and period
Mapping mutation and its audit event are committed atomically
